title: Remarks at Tower City, N.D
paragraphs: It is a great pleasure to greet you and to be back in North Dakota, where I spent so many years. I first came to the borders of the state in 1880, twenty-three years ago. I have passed through here generally on cattle trains. (Cheers and applause)
